Text.Text: By Allah! Lend us your support!
Will you stand by me?
I humbly request your help!
I am appealing to you for support!
You surely wouldn't leave me in the lurch?
Is there still hope for our cause?
Have you truly taken such efforts on my behalf?
My request... Have you actually fulfilled it?
Then maybe later, inshallah!
I am still pinning my hopes on you...
May Allah bless you for your help!
We are all greatly indebted to you...
It seems Allah has something else in mind...
Such a shame it has to end this way...
The desert is paradise compared to this Settlement!
By Allah! I can't take another day here!
I'm going to put my Tent up somewhere else...
Nomads will move out if they are unsatisfied…
Do you realise that we've never been so uncomfortable!?
By Allah! How about these for lean times…?!
What did we do to displease Allah so much?!
Even the Desert is more hospitable than this City!
The People are unhappy with life in this City!
I pray to Allah that good times will soon follow the bad...
We are but simple Nomads. We don't need much...
You were right! It IS better to live here than to move from Town to Town...
What could we want besides Food and water for ourselves and our Camels?!
Life has changed somewhat since we have been here… but it is good.
You can actually get used to life in a House built of Stone…
Is there anything finer than sitting in the shade eating Dates?
I sold loads of Camels at the bazaar today!
Allah is smiling down on this City!
I would never have thought that life would be so comfortable here…
I don't regret giving up the Nomad life!
Allah has heard my prayers! We are enjoying a better life than ever before!
An oasis of Peace and prosperity in the middle of the Desert… Allah be praised!
Since I came to live here, I've learnt the meaning of the word 'home'!
My family and I are truly thankful that we can live here completely free of worry!
We have all been blessed by Allah!
